name: iPayX
one_liner: iPayX Protocol: FINTRAC-registered FX forensic audit layer with an API and remote MCP server that compares bank FX rates to mid-market.
auth_notes: Audit API uses a Bearer token (key from ipayx.ai/ai-access). MCP: some tools need no auth; full_forensic_fx_report needs a Bearer API key.
access_notes: llms.txt lists API plans from $99/mo; MCP has free tools and 3 free audits per IP per month; key via ipayx.ai/ai-access (JS shell, not read).

buildability.rationale: A public API (POST fx-audit-engine, Bearer) and an official remote MCP exist; narrow FX audit scope and paid API plans. Docs are thin.

needs_human_reason: ipayx.ai pages are JS shells; ai-access and pricing details not rendered.

identity.quote: FINTRAC-registered (MSB C10001283) FX forensic audit layer. Real-time foreign-exchange auditing API and MCP server for AI agents

access.quote: Forensic Pack from $297, API plans from $99/mo.
3 free audits per IP per calendar month

buildability.quote: the server never moves money and never executes transfers. Audit information only

disputes.why: llms.txt lists API plans from $99/mo and an API key page; not contact-sales.
llms.txt and official MCP repo state Bearer token auth.
Vendor GitHub org repo mcp-fx-audit plus vendor-domain endpoint mcp.ipayx.ai.
Documented API endpoint fx-audit-engine and 4 MCP tools.
Public API and MCP documented in llms.txt and repo README; paid plans, narrow scope.
